title: The Botanical Garden Cactus Hat Scandal
crime_description: The rare hundred-year Saguaro cactus was crowned with a sombrero and glued-on googly eyes.

dossier.text: Security footage shows the suspect's face at 10:15 PM, 10 feet away from the cactus.
The cactus's base was found with a faint smudge of blue paint, matching the suspect's favorite dye.
Witnesses report seeing the suspect's knitting needles being hastily stashed in a nearby planter at 11:15 PM.

truth_timeline.event: Suspect prepares tools and sneaks in.

lie_plan.cover_story: I was just, uh, conducting a nocturnal botanical survey, and the cactus was already decorated. I swear, I'm innocent!

weak_points.claim: The cactus was decorated by a mischievous gang of desert rodents.
weak_points.planned_slip: Aye, I were just tryin' to distract the varmints with me knitting, savvy?

weak_points.claim: The blue paint smudge was just a, uh, art installation I was working on.
weak_points.planned_slip: I be a artiste, matey! Me paint be me passion!

weak_points.claim: The witnesses must've seen me stashing me knitting needles for... uh, a charity event.
weak_points.planned_slip: I be a good Samaritan, matey! Me needles be for the good of the community!

solution_contradictions: Suspect claimed the cactus was already decorated, which directly conflicts with fact-1.
Suspect claimed the blue paint smudge was an art installation, which directly conflicts with fact-2.
